understanding.mechanics_understanding: Each turn you choose a horizontal move (MOVE_LEFT/MOVE_RIGHT) or CLICK/UNDO. After any horizontal move, the character automatically travels/falls in the current gravity direction until it lands on a solid/support tile, hits a hazard (like spikes 'u'/'v' which cause an immediate loss), or reaches the goal '+'. CLICK targets a specific grid coordinate to remove a breakable/clickable block ('x') to open a path (and clicking does not move the player). UNDO reverses the previous action. Turn/attempt limits constrain how much repositioning and experimentation you can do.
